en: A black-and-white postcard showing an interior room filled with historical musical instruments, paintings, and some ornate furniture. There are string instruments, a keyboard instrument, a drum, and several framed artworks and objects on the wall. The architectural style and furnishing suggest a museum or historical house setting. The bottom left corner of the postcard contains text in French.
